paragraphs: Cinema Afternoon at Our School! Come and see a film on a big screen in the school hall. It is the funniest film of the year, and everybody loves it. The money helps the Explorers to pay for the next trip. Leo made this advertisement, and Teacher Kim checked it. Read the facts, and then choose your seat.

The title of the film is "The Brave Little Boat". It is a story about a small boat and a big storm. The boat is small, but it is very brave, and the end is happy. The film is on Saturday afternoon, in the school hall. The doors open at half past one. The film starts at two o'clock and ends at four o'clock. There is a short break in the middle. The break is ten minutes long, and the drinks are ready then.

A ticket costs thirty baht for a child and forty baht for an adult. A child under five does not pay. Buy your ticket from the assistant in the school office. You pay in cash, and the assistant gives you a receipt. Tickets are available until Thursday. Your ticket price also pays for a drink.

Do you want a perfect seat? The beanbags are green, and there are twenty of them. You can rent a beanbag for ten baht. It is the softest seat in the hall! Rent yours early, because only twenty beanbags are available. Popcorn is on sale, and a big box costs only ten baht. That is half of the usual price. A friendly assistant sells popcorn and juice at the back of the hall.

The screen is five meters wide, and the sound is very good. This is a great experience for the whole family. You will never forget it, because the screen is so big. Many children say that the best part is the music of the sea. Come early, because the best seats go fast. Children can bring a friend, and parents can come too. The cinema afternoon is a good plan for a hot Saturday. We want the hall to be full, so please tell your friends.

Please follow these rules. Turn off your phone in the hall. Do not bring your own food, and put your box in the bin. Do you have a question? Ask Teacher Kim or write a message in Explorers' Blog. See you at the cinema!
